import hashlib
import importlib.util
from io import BytesIO
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import pymupdf
from pypdf import PdfReader
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
from aspose.words_foss.saving import PdfSaveOptions

root = Path('/Users/sheny/Developer/code/Aspose.Words-FOSS-for-Python')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('nav_fixture', root / 'tests/test_pdf_repeated_header_navigation.py')
fixture = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(fixture)
result = {'probe_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'cases': {}}
for kind in ['heading', 'bookmark']:
    for nested in [False, True]:
        model = fixture.repeated_header_model(kind, nested)
        options = PdfSaveOptions()
        options.outline_options.headings_outline_levels = 6
        options.outline_options.create_outlines_for_headings_in_tables = True
        options.outline_options.bookmarks_outline_levels = {'Target': 1}
        raw = LdmPdfWriter(options).write_to_bytes(model)
        parsed = PdfReader(BytesIO(raw))
        with pymupdf.open(stream=raw, filetype='pdf') as pdf:
            result['cases'][f'{kind}-nested-{nested}'] = {
                'model_sha256': hashlib.sha256(model.model_dump_json().encode()).hexdigest(),
                'page_count':len(pdf),
                'pages':[{'text': page.get_text(), 'words':page.get_text('words'),
                    'decoded_stream_sha256':hashlib.sha256(parsed.pages[i]['/Contents'].get_object().get_data()).hexdigest(),
                    'pixels_sha256':hashlib.sha256(page.get_pixmap().samples).hexdigest()} for i,page in enumerate(pdf)],
                'link': {'page':pdf[0].get_links()[0]['page'], 'x':pdf[0].get_links()[0]['to'].x, 'y':pdf[0].get_links()[0]['to'].y},
                'outlines':[{'title':item.title, 'page':parsed.get_destination_page_number(item)} for item in parsed.outline],
            }
Path(f'/tmp/docweave-repeated-navigation-{sys.argv[1]}.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({name:{'pages':case['page_count'],'link_page':case['link']['page'],'outline_count':len(case['outlines'])} for name,case in result['cases'].items()}))
